scope.physical_geometry: Pixel 7a face-up in the user-established optimal near-field position over the MacBook function-key area; device must not be moved during this campaign
scope.environment: HVAC state unknown; retain passive room tone and do not infer an asserted HVAC state
scope.authorization: User explicitly requested the spike experiments and authorized acoustic playback/recording
scope.output_restriction: MacBook Pro built-in speakers only; Elgato Wave is prohibited
scope.input_restriction: MacBook Pro built-in microphone and Pixel 7a built-in microphone route only

hypothesis: Sequential per-speaker sounding in one phase-continuous stereo render, with both independently retained Pixel microphone rows and same-session passive noise, will yield a stable, nonduplicated 2x2 forward path matrix suitable for profile negotiation and will determine whether common-phase Rank-11 work is technically justified.

incumbent.description: The existing bench sounder usually excites one Mac output and analyzes a selected Pixel microphone. Tracked route evidence establishes two direct Pixel logical microphone mappings, but no retained phase-continuous full 2x2 H[k] matrix exists.

waveform.render: one phase-continuous stereo buffer per matrix; the inactive output column is exact digital zero
per_speaker_sequence: 8-symbol repeated known-QPSK OFDM sounder: NFFT 2048, CP 768, 1.1-23 kHz
64-symbol randomized 16-QAM rate-1/2 portable-C EVM frame: NFFT 2048, CP 768, 1.1-23 kHz

cells_and_frozen_order.action: Pixel stereo 10 s, then Mac mono 10 s; no playback

primary_metric.name: held-out-forward-path-repeatability
primary_metric.definition: For each of four Mac-speaker-to-Pixel-microphone paths, compare F2 with F1 on active bins selected without payload or CRC results. Report median and p90 absolute H-magnitude change, delay-spread change, tone-gain change, repeated-pilot SNR, EVM, and phase residual after common timing/CFO/SRO terms are removed.
primary_metric.active_bin_rule: The bin must have at least 12 dB repeated-pilot SNR in both F1 and F2.
primary_metric.promotion_threshold: All four forward paths retain at least 80% of occupied bins; median absolute magnitude change <=3 dB and p90 <=6 dB; -15 dB delay spread changes by no more than max(0.5 ms, 25%); route/source/channel mapping is exact and stable; no clipping or linearity stop fires.
primary_metric.common_phase_feasibility_threshold: After removing one common affine phase term per repeat, median per-bin repeat coherence >=0.95 and phase standard deviation <=15 degrees on bins with at least 20 dB SNR. This is only a Rank-11 go/no-go input, not a MIMO claim.

nonregressions.route: Every Pixel capture must exactly match the frozen UNPROCESSED stereo route and two distinct direct microphone mappings.
nonregressions.clipping: Zero source-reported clipped samples; absolute sample peak <0.985; clipped-sample fraction <=1e-5.
nonregressions.linearity: For the tone screen: minimum resolvable fundamental SNR >=12 dB, conservative THD <=-25 dBc, conservative IMD <=-30 dBc, within-stage gain jump <=4 dB, post-signal noise increase <=6 dB.
nonregressions.channel_identity: Do not claim independent microphones if exact equality, >=0.9995 delayed correlation, <=-35 dB scaled-copy residual, or passive covariance rank evidence indicates duplication.
nonregressions.goodput_semantics: EVM-frame strict ordered recovered bytes may be reported as probe delivery only. Descriptive Shannon/log-det/GMI arithmetic and scheduled ceilings must never be labeled measured application goodput.

sequential_stop_conditions: Stop all active work if Mac built-in output or requested built-in input cannot be selected and verified, or if Elgato is selected.
Stop before F1 if F0 route, clipping, or linearity nonregression fails.

Stop before F2 if F1 route or clipping fails; a high-frequency tone that is merely noise-limited is recorded separately from true distortion and may not silently pass the declared conservative linearity gate.

Stop a device-local or reverse branch immediately if capture peak reaches 0.985, source clipping is reported, the media-volume transaction cannot be restored, or the output-route provenance changes unexpectedly.
Do not replace failed cells, move the phone, tune thresholds, or select receivers using payload bytes/CRC results.

heldout_policy.forward: F1 is calibration; F2 is the only held-out repeat and reverses speaker order.
heldout_policy.reverse: R1 is calibration; R2 is held-out and reverses speaker order, but both remain descriptive because the existing play_pcm primitive lacks a strict parsed realized-output-route signature.

code_and_config.analysis_policy: Frozen metrics and thresholds above; analysis implementation may be added after acquisition, but its source hash and all post-freeze changes must be retained.
